title: This Bird Sleeps While Flying and Stays Aloft for 2 Months

scenes.text: This bird can fly for two months without ever landing.
It's a frigatebird, and it covers more than 250 miles every day.
So when does it sleep? In the air.
Scientists recorded its brain waves and found it naps in bursts of about ten seconds.
In total, it gets around 45 minutes of sleep a day while flying.
On land, it sleeps about twelve hours.
Two months in the air, and not one landing to rest.

description:
Frigatebirds can stay airborne for up to two months. A 2016 study in Nature Communications found they nap in the air in bursts of about ten seconds, about 45 minutes a day.
Could you sleep like that?
first_comment: Could you nap for ten seconds at a time and call it a night?
